name: Speaking Up
overview: Scripture calls believers to boldly and lovingly speak up for those who cannot defend themselves, advocating for justice and righteousness as seen in Proverbs 31:8-9. The Lord encourages His servants not to fear but to proclaim His truth confidently, exemplified by His instruction to Paul in Acts 18:9. Confessing Christ openly is essential for salvation and reflects the power of the gospel (Romans 1:16; 10:9), while Ephesians 4:15 reminds us to speak truth in love, fostering spiritual growth in Christ.
